name: Kabedon Kareshi ~Manatsu no Charaotoko~
original_name: 壁ドン彼氏 ～真夏のチャラ男～
source:
At a beach resort with university friends, you meet Yuki Reo, a wealthy heir with a flashy demeanor. Popular with girls, he becomes interested in you because you don't respond to his advances at all. What started as half-joking turns into a change in his attitude when you point out his fake smile.

[Translated From [url=https://ninten-switch.com/kabedon-kareshi-manatsu-no-for-nintendo-switch-2023-0302-released]Ninten-Switch[/url]]
translation:
在与大学朋友的海滩度假胜地，你遇到了风度浮夸的富有继承人Yuki Reo。受女孩欢迎，他会对你感兴趣，因为你根本不回应他的示爱。当你指出他的假笑时，一开始只是半开玩笑，他的态度就发生了变化。

[译自[url=https://ninten-switch.com/kabedon-kareshi-manatsu-no-for-nintendo-switch-2023-0302-released]Ninten-Switch[/url]]
